SourceSpanish.Title: Contacto hostil — 5 bajas FPS
SourceSpanish.Description: Consigue 5 bajas FPS confirmadas de jugadores distintos.
Rules: Exclusivamente en el universo persistente PU/LIVE; el video muestra tu identidad y la versión LIVE.
Baja posterior a aceptar el contrato y dentro de la temporada activa; video continuo del enfrentamiento, sin cortes dentro del combate.
Muerte confirmada e identificada en el video; una incapacitación no basta.
Víctima humana distinta en cada unidad; no cuentan NPC, aliados, cuentas alternativas ni resultados pactados.
Cada evidencia acredita una sola misión y una sola unidad; un cobro por misión y temporada con revisión manual.

Objectives.Name: Bajas FPS verificadas
Objectives.Description: Cada baja FPS de un jugador distinto, verificada en video.

English.Title: Hostile Contact — 5 FPS Kills
English.Description: Score 5 confirmed FPS kills against different players.
Rules: Only in the PU/LIVE persistent universe; the video must show your identity and the LIVE game version.
The kill must occur after contract acceptance and during the active season; record continuous video of the encounter with no cuts during combat.
A confirmed death identifiable in the video is required; incapacitation alone is insufficient.
A different human player for each unit; NPCs, allies, alternate accounts, and arranged outcomes do not count.
Each piece of evidence counts toward one mission and one unit only; one payout per mission and season, subject to manual review.

Objectives.Name: Verified FPS Kills
Objectives.Description: Each FPS kill of a different player, verified by video.
